statement: Promoting music on streaming services exposes artists to artificial streaming scams and bot farms that manipulate charts and risk account penalties.
normalized_problem: exposure to artificial streaming and fraudulent promotion scams
desired_outcome: Boost stream counts through authentic listener engagement without risking fraudulent activity or account action.
current_solutions: Relying strictly on organic audience building
Vetting playlist curators and third-party promotion services carefully
attempts: Using automated marketing platforms and external playlist submission services
solution_complaints: Distinguishing legitimate promotional services from bot farms is extremely difficult
Fraudulent streams distort audience analytics and put artist profiles at risk of removal or penalties
